'''Arnold''' (Japanese: '''ハジメ''' ''Hajime'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP027|Hypno's Naptime]]''. He is a [[doppelgänger]] of {{Ash}}, with the only differences being his clothing and hair color.

He was one of the children who became hypnotized by {{p|Hypno}}'s sleep waves, resulting in him becoming lost at the park. Luckily, {{p|Drowzee}}'s dream waves were able to wake him and the other children up. At the end of the episode, he was reunited with [[Arnold's mother|his mother]].
